description: Schema for Brand Equity and Market Reaction Linkage Readiness outputs. Defines DV roles, output columns, and constraint flags. No regression is run; no brand equity values are generated.

tobins_q.role: Primary long-run Brand Equity / firm value proxy
tobins_q.status: MISSING — financial statement panel not present in x_scrapper
allowed_expressions: long-run market valuation proxy for Brand Equity

CAR.basis: Event-study based market-based firm value response around 10-K filing dates
forbidden_expressions: CAR is equivalent to Tobin's Q

AbnormalVolume.basis: Event-study based abnormal trading volume around 10-K filing dates

same_month_alignment.definition: humor period (YYYY-MM) == YYYY-MM of 10-K filing date
same_month_alignment.limitation: Simultaneity risk: humor posts in the same month as filing may violate temporal ordering

prefiling_lag_alignment.definition: humor period == filing_month - 1, or within range [filing_month - 3, filing_month - 1]
prefiling_lag_alignment.limitation: Lag window choice requires theoretical justification
prefiling_lag_alignment.recommended_use: Primary alignment for regression: ensures temporal ordering (humor precedes filing)

brand_equity_market_reaction_linkage_rea.description: Per company-period linkage readiness flags. Unique key: company_name × period. Joins humor variables with crosswalk and korea_uni availability flags.

columns.name: company_name
columns.description: Fortune 500 company name (from humor variables)

columns.name: period
columns.description: YYYY-MM (from humor variables). Unique key with company_name.

columns.name: period_year
columns.description: YYYY extracted from period

columns.name: period_month
columns.description: MM extracted from period

columns.name: total_posts
columns.description: Total X posts for this firm-period

columns.name: humor_count
columns.description: Humor posts (v1 label)

columns.name: humor_share
columns.description: humor_count / total_posts (conservative)

columns.name: aggressive_count
columns.description: Aggressive humor posts (v1 label, rare class)

columns.name: aggressive_humor_usage_intensity
columns.description: aggressive_count / total_posts (H3 moderator)

columns.name: source_x_handle_count
columns.description: Number of X handles contributing to this firm-period

columns.name: source_x_handle_list
columns.description: Handles joined with '; '

columns.name: ticker_available
columns.description: 'true' if sec_ticker resolved in fortune crosswalk

columns.name: cik_available
columns.description: 'true' if sec_cik resolved in fortune crosswalk

columns.name: matched_ticker
columns.description: Resolved ticker symbol (empty if not resolved)

columns.name: matched_cik
columns.description: Resolved SEC CIK (empty if not resolved)

columns.name: matched_korea_uni_company_name
columns.description: Company name as it appears in korea_uni event data

columns.name: korea_uni_match_status
columns.description: matched | partial_match | unmatched | korea_uni_data_not_available

columns.name: tobins_q_available
columns.description: Always 'false' — financial panel not present

columns.name: tobins_q_join_ready
columns.description: Always 'false' at this stage

columns.name: tobins_q_blocking_reason
columns.description: Reason Tobin's Q join is not possible

columns.name: car_outcome_available

columns.name: matched_event_count
columns.description: Number of 10-K filing events for matched company in korea_uni

columns.name: nearest_filing_date
columns.description: Filing date of nearest event to this humor period

columns.name: nearest_event_trading_date
columns.description: First trading date at/after nearest filing

columns.name: nearest_target_report_year

columns.name: nearest_event_time_gap_days
columns.description: Absolute day gap between humor period start and nearest filing date

columns.name: CAR_m1_p1_available

columns.name: CAR_0_p1_available
columns.description: 'true' if CAR_0_p1 present and company matched

columns.name: CAR_0_p3_available
columns.description: 'true' if CAR_0_p3 present and company matched

columns.name: CAR_0_p5_available
columns.description: 'true' if CAR_0_p5 present and company matched

columns.name: AbnormalVolume_0_p1_available
columns.description: 'true' if AbnormalVolume_0_p1 present and company matched

columns.name: AbnormalVolume_0_p3_available
columns.description: 'true' if AbnormalVolume_0_p3 present and company matched

columns.name: AbnormalVolume_0_p5_available
columns.description: 'true' if AbnormalVolume_0_p5 present and company matched

columns.name: placebo_outcome_available
columns.description: 'true' if any placebo outcome column present and company matched

columns.name: prefiling_lag_alignment_ready

dv_candidate_variable_dictionary.csv.description: Dictionary of all DV candidates for H1-H3 regression. 13 candidates covering Tobin's Q, CAR, AbnormalVolume, and placebo outcomes.

brand_equity_market_reaction_missing_inp.description: List of missing inputs required to proceed with regression. One row per missing item.
